statistic.name: other
statistic.notes: Standardized regression coefficients for Sense of Belonging, controlling for psychological sense of school membership, trait anxiety, and math identification: math anxiety -.70, usefulness of math .59, math confidence .77, intent to pursue math .42 (all p < .001; Table 6). Sense of Belonging was the strongest predictor of intent to pursue math.

sample.description: Study 2: students at a highly selective university in the Northeast US who attended both lab sessions (30 men, 43 women; 133 attended the first).

source.citation: Good, C., Rattan, A., & Dweck, C. S. (2012). Why do women opt out? Sense of belonging and women's representation in mathematics. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 102(4), 700-717.

needs_check: Confirm the n for the regression analyses (the other scales report n = 77-78).
